name: io.github.robertdoneill/jmap-calendar-mcp
description: Read calendars and create, change or (opt-in) delete events on any JMAP server, such as Stalwart.

environmentVariables.name: JMAP_BEARER_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: API key for the account, limited to calendar permissions

environmentVariables.name: JMAP_ALLOW_INVITES
environmentVariables.description: 1 to allow sending invitations when a call asks for it
